analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($690.49) vs SMA5 ($712.98)/SMA20 ($728.19)/SMA50 ($724.70): below short/mid-term moving averages, indicating a weak trend position.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($718.45)/SMA200 ($678.38): mid-to-long term trend weakening, above SMA200.
· 52-week position (65.1%) + current price approaching historical low range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (36.6→34.9): entering oversold territory, maintaining downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (hist -5.1683→-3.1159): improving, signaling bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower band $688.96): approaching lower band, with band width widening to 10.77%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($686.37): above Pivot S1 ($661.67), based on moving averages.
· Swing resistance ($721.89): resistance from SMA20/50, potential trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: sideways range, lack of directional trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (2.61x vs 5-day average): surge, adding conviction to price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis: Accumulation phase, conditions for entry: RSI recovery above 40 and MACD golden cross confirmation.
